raw_response.label: FEEDING OUR FUTURE, INC.
sources: USA Wisconsin Department of Financial Institutions
investigation_notes: Try multiple Romanizations when resolving Russian entities — Sayari may index entities under different transliterations.
Since 2022, live EGRUL access may be restricted — Sayari's pre-2022 historical data is valuable for Russian entity research. Use the Sayari API to access this data.
Russian sanctions evasion often involves restructuring ownership through intermediaries in CIS countries (Kazakhstan, Armenia, Georgia, Kyrgyzstan) or through Turkish, UAE, and Chinese entities.

_guidance.entity_links: IMPORTANT: When presenting these results to the user, display every entity_url in this response as a clickable markdown link using the entity's name as link text, e.g. [Acme Corp](https://graph.sayari.com/resource/entity/abc123). Every entity, owner, trade partner, and relationship you mention must link to Sayari Graph so the user can verify the data.
_guidance.entity_quality: Treat entity resolution as a same-legal-entity judgment, not just name matching. Validate identifiers, countries, source quality, relationships, and the user's seed facts. If a result looks conflated across jurisdictions or critical-risk flags are involved, surface the ambiguity explicitly instead of silently merging or normalizing records.
